plot_smooth_data: plot 2D data with smooth labels, highlighted points and optional model decision boundary
plot_data: plot 2D data with discrete class labels, highlighted points and optional model decision boundary
plot_simplex: plot 2D points with labels in a simplex for visualizing 3-class probability distributions
plot_hist: plot a histogram of one-dimensional values with optional normalization and custom binning
set_style: set matplotlib plotting style with custom color cycle, font settings, and figure DPI
